measurements.name: LV_long
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left ventricle longitudinal (base-apex) diameter.

measurements.name: LV_trans
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left ventricle transverse diameter.

measurements.name: RV_long
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right ventricle longitudinal diameter.

measurements.name: RV_trans
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right ventricle transverse diameter.

measurements.name: LA_long
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left atrium longitudinal diameter.

measurements.name: LA_trans
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left atrium transverse diameter.

measurements.name: RA_long
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right atrium longitudinal diameter.

measurements.name: RA_trans
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right atrium transverse diameter.

measurements.name: HSD
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the head-symphysis distance.

measurements.name: AOP
measurements.description: angle of progression between pubic symphysis axis and fetal skull tangent
measurements.instructions: Mark the angle of progression between pubic symphysis axis and fetal skull tangent: its vertex, then the end points of its two arms.

measurements.name: FA
measurements.instructions: Place the four caliper points of the fetal abdominal circumference: the two short-axis endpoints, then the two long-axis endpoints.

measurements.name: CL
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the cervical length.

measurements.name: BPD
measurements.instructions: Place the four caliper points of the biparietal diameter: the two short-axis endpoints, then the two long-axis endpoints.

measurements.name: HC
measurements.instructions: Place the four caliper points of the fetal head circumference: the two short-axis endpoints, then the two long-axis endpoints.

measurements.name: IVC
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the inferior vena cava diameter.

measurements.name: LV
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left ventricle internal diameter.

measurements.name: RV
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right ventricle diameter.

measurements.name: IVS
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the interventricular septum thickness.

measurements.name: LVPW
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left ventricle posterior wall thickness.

measurements.name: VAO
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the aortic sinus of Valsalva diameter.

measurements.name: STJ
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the sinotubular junction diameter.

measurements.name: AAO
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the ascending aorta diameter.

measurements.name: AV
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the aortic valve annulus diameter.

measurements.name: LVOT
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left ventricular outflow tract diameter.

measurements.name: LA
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the left atrium anteroposterior diameter.

measurements.name: RVOT
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right ventricular outflow tract diameter.

measurements.name: RVOT
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the right ventricular outflow tract diameter.

measurements.name: PA
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the main pulmonary artery diameter.

measurements.name: FL
measurements.instructions: Place the two caliper endpoints of the femur length.
